parts.headline: AI Lenders Are Financing the End of Scarcity
parts.question: Who writes the checks for the buildout?

call.line: Lenders are right to finance capacity and wrong to assume it stays scarce. Scarcity is a season; debt is a contract.
actions: Haircut any loan secured by compute scarcity: the collateral decays as supply catches up.
Measure cash flow against the $2 trillion it needs, from about $600 billion today, every quarter.
Count the $2.7 trillion of off-balance-sheet commitments as leverage, because creditors will.
flips: September-quarter cash flow moves visibly toward $2 trillion.
The first Blackwell renewal holds its price without new guarantees.
